title: Playboy Book of Lingerie Magazine Lot of 4 1992 1995 Vintage + 1 Random Magazine
descriptionText:
Condition:
Pre-owned vintage magazines in good overall condition for their age. Covers show normal storage and handling wear, including light scuffs, edge/corner wear and minor creasing. Please review all photos carefully for exact condition. Sold as pictured.

Description:
Lot of 4 vintage Playboy’s Book of Lingerie special-edition magazines.

Includes:

* Playboy’s Book of Lingerie — January/February 1992 — “Secrets of Sexy Intimate Wear”
* Playboy’s Book of Lingerie — March/April 1992 — “Lose Your Heart to Luscious Intimate Apparel”
* Playboy’s Book of Lingerie — July/August 1992 — “Festive Summer Intimate Apparel”
* Playboy’s Book of Lingerie — January/February 1995 — “Silky Sentiments of Love”

All 4 magazines pictured are included and sold together as one lot.

Excellent group for someone collecting Playboy’s Book of Lingerie series, with three different 1992 issues plus a January/February 1995 issue.

Vintage pre-owned magazines may have age-related shelf, storage and handling wear. Please use the photos as the primary reference for condition and exactly what is included.

Quantity: 4 magazines

Series: Playboy’s Book of Lingerie

Publisher: Playboy

Format: Magazine / Special Edition

Language: English

Dates: Jan/Feb 1992, Mar/Apr 1992, Jul/Aug 1992 & Jan/Feb 1995

Sale: Lot of 4 + 1
